title: [dev-g] NSClient / NSClientV3 preferences
symptom: When opening preferences from NSClient, only NS API Secret is shown, and from NSClient v3 only NS Access Token is shown. But after navigating into a submenu and back, both parameters appear simultaneously, which is confusing.
cause: The issue may be linked to a bug in the Preferences menu that results in all preference categories being expanded after navigating back, causing conditions that filter entries to not be re-evaluated.
fix: A commit was made to address the issue: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/f877bb5fb9492f42fc885133e5bb859ffdc0ffa1
evidence_quote: My guess is that the menus all have conditions in them that choose which entries are shown based on config, but those conditions aren't always checked when the menu is loaded a second time via a "back".
